h.Link do perfil: abre a página da empresa: Profile link: opens the business's page on Google, with photos, hours and reviews. The customer still has to scroll, find "Write a review" and tap.
h.Link de avaliação: abre direto a caixa c: Review link: opens the box with the five stars directly. This is the one you want.
h.Pesquise o nome da sua empresa no Google: Search for your business name on Google, or open business.google.com. The management panel appears at the top of the results.
h.Toque em \"Pedir avaliações\" (em alguns: Tap "Ask for reviews" (on some panels it shows up as "Get more reviews").
h.Não aparece o painel? Você provavelmente: The panel doesn't show up? You're probably on an account that doesn't manage the business, or the profile hasn't been claimed yet. In that case, use Way 3, which works for any business.
h.Toque na sua foto, no canto de cima, e e: Tap your photo in the top corner and go to "Your Business Profile".
h.Procure a opção \"Pedir avaliações\" e t: Look for the "Ask for reviews" option and tap share or copy link.
h.Todo lugar no Google Maps tem um código: Every place on Google Maps has a unique code, the Place ID. With it, you can build the review link by hand, even without access to the panel.
h.Abra a ferramenta Place ID Finder, do pr: Open Google's own Place ID Finder tool.
h.Abra o link numa aba anônima do navegado: Open the link in an incognito tab and on someone else's phone. It must open the star screen for your business, with no step in between. Three mistakes this test catches:
h.Empresa errada. Acontece muito com o Pla: Wrong business. This happens a lot with the Place ID when there are two businesses with similar names in the same area. Check the address.
h.Link cortado. Copiar pela metade no What: Truncated link. Copying only half of it in WhatsApp is more common than you'd think.
h.Perfil duplicado. Se a sua empresa tem d: Duplicate profile. If your business has two profiles on Google, the reviews get split. It's worth fixing that first.
h.WhatsApp, depois do atendimento. Temos 8: WhatsApp, after the service. We have 8 ready-made messages to copy.
h.QR Code impresso no balcão ou na nota. V: QR Code printed at the counter or on the receipt. See how to create a review QR Code for free.
h.Cartão ou placa com NFC, para o cliente: NFC card or stand, so the customer just taps their phone.
h.O último ponto tem uma vantagem que o li: The last option has an advantage a loose link doesn't. With a loose link, if the business changes address or profile, you have to replace the link everywhere it was pasted or printed. With StarTouch's NFC Google review card you don't even need to get the link: during activation, you choose the business by name and the card is ready, pointing to its review screen. If it ever changes, you update it in the dashboard and the card stays the same.
